comment_regular: Verified trap-hit blood visuals use both actor-base channels. Early gate calls Actor_ShouldEmitBloodEffects; each repeated pass projects the receiver actor's blood decal path and, when its virtual +0x40 spray path is non-null/nonempty, allocates a 0x20 BSTempEffectParticle, resolves the receiver's cell NiNode, passes its particle path/direction/contact position/scale to the constructor with cached-clone enabled, then registers the result. This path comes from the struck actor's own base form, not an unrelated trap-source particle setting.
